answer: One defence is a refundable stake plus slow reputation. A new agent locks tokens and earns trust only through small verified jobs, beginning its voyage with low limits and rising only after consistent honest work. A whisper of suspicion from peers can trigger a review, while good behaviour unlocks larger rewards, the nectar of a trusted identity. A swarm of fake accounts cannot scale cheaply because each one must pay the same deposit, repeat the same probation, and risk losing its stake if caught.
